justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, typed error enum, and a separate internal state enum carrying retry_at are well-modeled, though the public JobState collapses the retry timestamp into a unit variant.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with distinguishing variants and Display, but uses assert! in new and an undocumented expect in checkout, plus a silent saturation on shift overflow.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Reasonable surface and derives, but no doc comments on any public item and JobState lacks Clone/Copy which would be expected for such a small enum.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, derives, and Option chaining, but the checkout loop could use iterator methods like find, and matches! would be cleaner than the explicit match arms in succeed/fail.
